svg.style: font-family: Lato, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, "Liberation Sans", sans-serif; font-feature-settings: "liga", "kern", "calt", "lnum"; text-rendering: geometricprecision; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; font-size: 16px; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);

text.style: font-size: 12px; line-height: 1;
text.tspan: GDP per capita (international-$ in 2021 prices; plotted on a logarithmic axis)

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1;
text.tspan: Share of dietary energy from protein
